description: Beige Book from the Federal Reserve — the eight-times-a-year summary of current economic conditions gathered by the 12 Federal Reserve Districts: the national summary or one district's report (Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Cleveland, Richmond, Atlanta, Chicago, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Kansas City, Dallas, San Francisco) split into its sections (Overall Economic Activity, Labor Markets, Prices, and the district's industry sections). Answers "what does the latest Beige Book say about the Dallas district", "Beige Book labor market conditions", "regional economic conditions per the Fed".

district.description: District name, city, or number 1–12 (e.g. "Dallas", "Kansas City", "11"). Default: the national summary.

edition.description: Edition as YYYY-MM or YYYYMM (e.g. "2026-07"). Default: the latest published edition.

name: beige_book
